# Pocket Gull — Real-Time AI Clinical Copilot & Care Plan Engine

> Pocket Gull is a high-performance, real-time medical Care Plan Strategy and Live AI Consult engine powered by Google Gemini and Vertex AI. It provides actionable clinical intelligence, manages patient states via FHIR R4 standards, and offers real-time bi-directional live voice consultations.

## Docs
- [Platform Architecture & Clinical Paradigms](https://pocketgull.app/docs/overview.md): Comprehensive system architecture, multi-paradigm clinical lenses, and diagnostic engines.
- [WebMCP Tool Interface & Schema Catalog](https://pocketgull.app/api/webmcp/tools): JSON Schema registry for autonomous AI browser tools and agentic navigation.
- [Agent Manifest & Discovery](https://pocketgull.app/.well-known/agent.json): Standardized agent discovery manifest declaring protocol versions, authentication, and endpoints.
- [OpenAPI REST Specification](https://pocketgull.app/docs/openapi.json): Full REST API contract for clinical, billing, and telemetry endpoints.

## Clinical Capabilities
- **Real-Time Gemini Live Audio**: Sub-250ms voice triage and multi-turn conversational consults.
- **Three.js WebGL 3D Anatomy**: Procedural bone, organ, and dermatome mapping with interactive lesion tagging.
- **Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM)**: Time-in-Range (TIR) analysis, glycemic variability, and eA1c tracking.
- **Teledentistry FDI Odontogram**: 32-tooth surface caries mapping and periodontal-cardiovascular inflammatory index.
- **Biometric Respiratory Spectrogram**: 24-band FFT acoustic spectral analyzer classifying wheezing, stridor, and cough bursts.
- **FHIR R4 Interoperability**: Strict FHIR R4 Bundle export for EHR integration (Epic, Cerner, AthenaHealth).

## WebMCP Tools
- `get_patient_state`: Inspect active patient demographics, vitals, lab results, and reported symptoms.
- `update_patient_vitals`: Push updated vital signs (HR, BP, SpO2, Temp, CGM Glucose).
- `generate_care_plan`: Request multi-paradigm clinical plan generation across specialized lenses.
- `toggle_dermatome_layer`: Adjust 3D WebGL viewport and nerve layer visualization.
- `generate_specialist_handoff`: Serialize clinical state into an SBAR specialist referral summary.
